page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a printed title at the head; small reference marks and a bracket in the right margin; catchword at the right foot.

main_text.p: Ex intimo corde igitur, Christum Dominum ac redemptorem deprecor, ut omnium potestatum, regum atque regnorum misereatur: & ita gentes omnes gubernandae curet, ut omnia tendant ad nominis sui gloriam: cuius uindicandae gratia potissimum, me quoq; in hac mea senecta perfortiter concitauit, nullius tamen Christiani principis honori derogandi aut detrahendi studio. Sed iam Romanam Bestiam, Satanae synagogam, cum fessore Antichristo atq; eius ductore diabolo, scripturis & eruditissimorum virorum testimonijs adorior.

Si acerbiora in hoc & altero meo opere sint dicta (pie lector) quam uelles, consideras immanissimam esse eius monstri in hac mundi uespera tyrannidem, eiusq; iuxta diuinas promissiones exitium in foribus esse. Concidet Babylon magna, quae gentes seduxit, & in interitum ibit, mirantibus cunctis qui terram inhabitant. Si offendit styli uehementia: contemplare eximium illum spiritus uigorem in Dauide propheta ac rege sanctissimo, qui in Domini causa perfortiter clamabat: Odivi ecclesiam malignantium, Psal. 25. Et iterum: Iniquos odio habui, quod legem tuam dilexerim, Psal. 118. Alibi quoq; Nonne qui oderunt te Domine, oderā, & super inimicos tuos tabescebam? Perfecto odio oderā illos, Psal. 128[?]. Promittit deinde per Prophetas suos

page.notes: Right margin: small reference marks (c, c, and a bracket spanning the lines beside "Satanae" and "tyrannidem") stand beside the lines "Concidet", "in interitum" and "terram", and beside "Sa-lam"; they carry no printed words, so none are transcribed. The word beginning the first line of the second paragraph after "Sa" is read as "Jam" with [?]; it could be misread. The Psalm reference "128" is uncertain. The word "Sa lam" at the start of the first paragraph is shown as "Jam" with [?] above; the scan is faint there. The catchword "fuos" is at the right foot. No page number is printed.
